title: Text-to-organism design
headline: Text-to-blueprint tool is live at /t/organism/: ten body > organ system > organ > tissue > cell trees, every node an ontology term with its query. The flying-fish demo exposed a gap: nothing matched "pectoral fins", so the defining structure was absent. Fixed, and every blueprint now reports the words it could not read and everything its per-parent limits cut, so a missing structure can no longer be mistaken for one the ontology lacks. All 35 thread records are drafted as Delphi v2.0 nanopublications, checked, unsigned, and naming no person.
